title: acre writes a drawing as SVG
body: acre renders only to PNG, through `render::draw_frame` and `acre render`. A figure for a paper needs vector output. Jack wants this when he publishes a figure, not before. The scene already lowers to a short list of `Primitive`s, so an SVG writer is a second renderer over the same list, with text set as outlines or as `<text>` in the embedded fonts.
